source_snapshot.procedure: Select a firmware update container, run `nvsm show firmware`, `nvsm update firmware`, then show firmware again.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Misses the state-changing firmware update and validates only inventory output.

historical_reviews.related_cases: Row351 supplies a GPU firmware image parameter and remains a separate source variant.

original_test_intent: Inventory installed DGX firmware, apply the explicitly approved firmware container to its allowlisted components, activate it as required, and prove the intended versions and platform health afterward.
original_method: Pin NVSM and container; capture component identities, active-bank versions and preserved logs; verify signature/hash, compatibility, dependencies, target allowlist, power/OOB and rollback; run the exact approved update once; perform required activation or reboot; re-inventory every target and verify platform services, PCIe/GPU/BMC health and log deltas.
manual_activity: Firmware owner supplies and approves the signed container, per-component version plan, activation order and recovery path; operator owns maintenance isolation, stable power and OOB recovery.
required_inputs: Approved NVSM build and exact update syntax
Signed firmware container with immutable hash
Component identity/current-target-active version and dependency map
Stable redundant power, OOB console and maintenance approval
safety_requirements: Never run an unscoped firmware update
Verify artifact signature/hash and every target before mutation
Maintain stable power and OOB console through activation
Stop on version, health, power or service anomaly; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate artifact, targets, version graph, approval and recovery
Execute one precisely approved update and activation sequence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It is incomplete because it reduces a firmware-update testcase to read-only inventory.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-supported command only with the approved immutable container and explicit component allowlist; never issue a bare unscoped update.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Container selection, pre/post firmware display and actual update coverage are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the firmware operation as a signed, allowlisted, versioned transaction with pre-state, activation, post-state and rollback evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds component scope, artifact identity, dependencies, activation, health and recovery gates while preserving the source update.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only `show` evidence cannot replace the required update path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong, interrupted or incompatible image can make one or more platform components unavailable or unbootable.

project_override_considerations: The platform firmware owner must define which container release and component targets are supported for this DGX configuration and whether staged banks or coordinated reboot are required.
expected_evidence: Pre-update inventory and preserved log snapshot
Complete update output, exit status, timestamps and activation/reboot record
Rollback readiness or executed recovery and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require firmware inventory plus update; the DeepSeek coverage omission is a historical-review defect, not a Master-source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if exact signed artifact, targets, version compatibility, stable power/OOB or rollback cannot be established.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row350 Wistron-NV GPU-00343-V002: approve the exact signed NVSM firmware container/hash, component target allowlist, current/target/active-bank versions, compatibility/dependency/order, update/activation/reboot semantics, stable-power/OOB monitoring and rollback/recovery; preserve logs and block any unscoped update.

review_improvement: Restores the source's omitted firmware-update coverage and converts a dangerous global command into an auditable per-component change transaction.
independent_technical_reasoning: A successful command exit does not establish firmware acceptance: every intended component must move from a recorded current version to the approved active version, survive activation, and remain healthy. Artifact identity, target scope and rollback are therefore part of the test oracle rather than optional setup notes.
